cases.explain: «ароматным маслом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.

cases.explain: «долгого пути» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.

cases.explain: «бурному морю» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.
